pages.title: THE WORLD REMEMBERS
pages.text:
SCHEMIN ’26
THE WEEKLY FANTASY MEMO
WEEK 4
OCTOBER 6, 2026
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE
SAME LEAGUE. HIGHER STAKES.

THE WORLD REMEMBERS

The last unbeaten owner in Schemin’ spent Week 4 looking downhill.

Three weeks built the map. Wins carved territory. Losses left scars. Rivalries found their roads. Objects started to matter.

But this week, nobody traveled anywhere new.

That’s divisional week here. Nobody gets a new opponent. They get somebody who already knows where the door is.

At the top of the mountain, D0nkey K0ng still stood unbeaten — dangerous, a target, and exactly where everyone expected him.

Then came ObiWan Jacoby.

Behind that headline, five other battles played out across a league that doesn’t sit still — hunters in the marsh, golfers on the coast, chili dogs in the city, the LLC at the exchange, a king with a crown, and a storm on the horizon.

Same league. Same territories. But none of it feels the same anymore.

pages.title: THE ROAD BACK UP
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
WEEK 4 · OVERTURE · W4-OV01

THE ROAD BACK UP
D0NKEY K0NG vs OBIWAN JACOBY

For three Sundays, everybody in Burgers had been looking at the same silhouette on the ridge.

D0nkey K0ng had taken the highest ground in the division and made the view look permanent. Every road below him seemed to end in somebody else’s loss.

ObiWan Jacoby knew that road already.

He had spent the opening month collecting proof that his roster could hurt people in more than one place. Puka. Walker. Henry. Deebo. Enough answers that the question was no longer whether he could climb.

It was what happened when he reached the top.

The highlands did not need another visitor.

They needed somebody willing to make the owner of the hill look down.

pages.title: SOME PEOPLE CALL IT OVERPREPARED
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
TWELVE OWNERS. ONE UNIVERSE. RIVALRIES. STORYLINES. LEGENDS. FOREVER.

SOME PEOPLE CALL IT OVERPREPARED

Pitts had spent the week replacing pieces.
Receipts. Waiver claims. New names. New combinations. Enough roster movement to make Three Dreaded Snake look less like a lineup and more like a construction site that had finally passed inspection.

Mud Dogs arrived with a simpler theory.
Find the swamp. Trust the nose. Figure the rest out when something starts moving.

That was the difference at sunrise.
One side had three sets of eyes, a rebuilt roster and more equipment than anybody wanted to carry. The other had confidence, plywood and absolutely no reason to believe the plywood was the problem.

By the time the wetlands woke up, both plans were technically still alive.
Only one of them looked like it had been tested beforehand.

pages.title: THE COAST WAS SUPPOSED TO HELP
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
TWELVE OWNERS. ONE UNIVERSE. RIVALRIES. STORYLINES. LEGENDS. FOREVER.

THE COAST WAS SUPPOSED TO HELP

A week after the chili dog, Duckhook wanted distance.
Not a speech. Not revenge. Just somewhere with salt air, a drink and enough ocean between him and the rest of the Wings division to let the joke get old without him.

Red Leopards volunteered to come along.
That part seemed generous. Red had spent the first month reminding the league that patience could look a lot like mercy right up until the moment it stopped being merciful. On the coast, though, there was no chase. No wager. No mountain.

Just two division rivals, a resort, and an afternoon that might have passed for recovery.

Then Red’s golf bag came out of the car.
Duckhook had picked the right place to escape the league.

He had brought the wrong person.

PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
WEEK 4 · OVERTURE · W4-OV04

THE INVITATION
SLOB ON MY DOBB vs THE CHILI CHEESERS

By the time Chili reached Slob’s place, everybody in Wings knew what he had done to Duckhook.

The chili dog had become a story before the box score was cold. The Dark Horse had carried an outlaw through another week, and Brandon Pryor arrived at the cave with exactly the kind of reputation that makes a host pour the first drink a little heavier.

Slob did not act threatened.
He opened the door.

Inside were too many televisions, too much memorabilia, enough neon to turn midnight into a commercial break, and one homemade championship belt sitting where Chili could definitely see it.

Nobody explained the belt.
Nobody needed to.

The invitation had sounded social.
The room had other plans.

pages.title: TWO TICKETS, ONE WINDOW
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
TWELVE OWNERS. ONE UNIVERSE. RIVALRIES. STORYLINES. LEGENDS. FOREVER.

TWO TICKETS, ONE WINDOW

Pittsy’s Book is neutral ground only if nobody asks who the house is rooting for.
The LLC arrived with a model, a cigar and the kind of confidence that makes a man buy his own number. His Majesty’s Blood arrived wearing the belt and bought himself too.

Two customers. Two self-tickets. One counter.
That was the clean version.

The less clean version was that both men had spent the season learning different lessons about control. The LLC trusted numbers because numbers usually behaved. The Belt Keeper had already learned that a win could arrive with a season-altering loss attached to it.

Neither came to the Waterfall Temple looking for philosophy.
They came for receipts.

By kickoff, Pittsy had both.

pages.title: THE BAROMETER MOVED FIRST
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE 2026
TWELVE OWNERS. ONE UNIVERSE. RIVALRIES. STORYLINES. LEGENDS. FOREVER.

THE BAROMETER MOVED FIRST

Before the storm reached Whipple’s trailer park, it started in a house across Pizza.
Nothing dramatic.
A toy underfoot. Food on the floor. Somebody yelling from the wrong room. Another small disaster arriving before the last one had been cleaned up.

El Niño kept absorbing it.

Across the region, Seven Deadly Chins had a quieter evening. An RV. A lawn chair. A drink. The kind of stillness that makes weather feel like somebody else’s problem.

For a while, it was.
Then the air changed.
Not enough to send anyone running. Just enough to move an awning, turn a few leaves over and make the clouds look like they had somewhere specific to be.

Whipple did not know what was coming.
El Niño did.
He was already living in it.

pages.title: STATE OF THE REALM
pages.text:
SCHEMIN ’26
THE WEEKLY FANTASY MEMO
WEEK 4
OCTOBER 2026

STATE OF THE REALM
THREE DIVISIONS. ONE REALITY.

BURGERS
THE HIGHLANDS
THE HILL STILL BREATHES.
STANDINGS
D0NKEY K0NG 3-1
OBIWAN JACOBY 3-1
THREE DREADED SNAKE 2-2
MUD DOGS 2-2
ANALYSIS
The Burgers remain the league’s gravity. DK is still the figure on the mountain, but the hill is no longer untouched — ObiWan stands right beside him at 3-1. TDS steadied the ship, and the Mud Dogs keep it ugly. The highlands are crowded, and every step up here costs more than it did a month ago.

WINGS
THE COAST
DIFFERENT WEATHER. SAME FIGHT.
STANDINGS
RED LEOPARDS 3-1
SLOB ON MY DOBB 2-2
THE CHILI CHEESERS 2-2
DR. DUCKHOOK 1-3
ANALYSIS
The Red Leopards lead the Wings at 3-1 and look more like Week 2 than Week 1. Slob on my Dobb stays in the mix, and the Chili Cheesers refuse to go away. Down at the Club, Duckhook is searching for answers at 1-3. In the Wings, the margins are thin and the wind never really stops.

PIZZA
THE WATERFALLS
SOME ODDS ARE BIGGER THAN FOOTBALL.
STANDINGS
HIS MAJESTY’S BLOOD 2-2
EL NIÑO 2-2
THE LLC 1-3
SEVEN DEADLY CHINS 1-3
ANALYSIS
The Pizza Division is balanced but volatile. HMB is 2-2 and still finding its footing after the Achane loss. El Niño matched him at 2-2 as the storm rolls in. The LLC and Seven Deadly Chins sit at 1-3, both looking to avoid digging a hole that even Pittsy’s Book might not price correctly.

AT THE TOP
Red Leopards, D0nkey K0ng and ObiWan Jacoby sit at 3-1, forming one of the tightest top trios of the season. The mountain is no longer alone, and the road ahead is anything but quiet.
THE MIDDLE
Six teams live at 2-2, and the middle of the league looks exactly like Schemin’ — crowded, loud and one week away from a whole new story.
AT THE BOTTOM
The LLC, Dr. Duckhook and Seven Deadly Chins sit at 1-3. The season is far from over, but the margin for error is gone, and in this league, holes have a way of getting deeper.
